items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: I just bought a book, Max Moran's book, A Hundred Rides.

ctx.x: D-F-Lovinet. I just bought a book, Max Moran's book, A Hundred Rides. I sent my fifteen dollars away and I got, I have a terrible time reading.
But I gotta learn the rags because this is the music.
